name: save_document
description: Validate then persist the session docx; the default policy permits pre-existing validation errors when no new normalized error signatures are detected. Save-blocked remedies are xpath-specific (drawing docPr/id, table tbl/tr/tc, relationships, header/footer parts, session tracking-attribute leaks each name their own fix). Optional commit params: message (commit subject, single-line, max 500 chars; newlines become spaces; blank/omitted falls back to `save_document: rev <n> (<k> ops since last save)`); author (max 100 chars; blank/omitted falls back to ASTra Agent). Over-long message/author fail at the handler with E_VALIDATION plus a shorten-and-retry remedy (never a bare MCP -32602: caps are enforced in the handler, not the wire schema). A successful save clears the session dirty flag (revision is re-synced to the file on disk). When dc:title is still a template placeholder ("Blank Document", "Report") the save writes it from the cover title, the first Title or the first Heading 1 and reports title and titleSetFrom; a title already set is never changed. A file that already had validator errors when it was opened is saved when the edit adds none: the envelope then carries validation:{ok:false,valid:false,errorCount,tolerated:true,preExistingErrors,introducedErrors:0,messages}; a clean save carries validation:{ok:true,valid:true,errorCount:0}. An edit that adds an error is refused with E_VALIDATION naming both numbers, with errorCount and the first 10 errors as errors[{description,xPath}] (validate_document lists them all). Pass {"strict":true} (or start the server with --strict-validation, or set ASTRA_STRICT_VALIDATION=1) to refuse every validator error as before. Paragraphs that share a w14:paraId are renumbered by the save: the first keeps its id, each later copy gets a new one and is listed in normalized, and the state before is recorded in the history (revert_document returns it); strict refuses such a document instead. The success envelope also carries revisionsPending (every revision element left in the saved package; a move counts as each of its markers) plus a revisionsRemedy when >0. The success envelope also carries advisory changedValues [{nodeId,before,after}] (old saved text -> new live text, bounded: at most 20 entries, each side at most 200 chars, truncated flag honest; empty + reason when no baseline is computable). When the session carries a style guide (new_document/compose_document styleGuide), the envelope also carries advisory styleWarnings [{nodeId,rule,message}] (table contrast, chart duplicate colors, split-table orphans), never blocking. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"path":"documents/report.docx"}. Always save after execute_batch; close afterwards. IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions, and duplicate client-supplied ids are rejected. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
